item.description: - Adds a standalone Home button next to Back and Forward in the titlebar when viewing Settings, Usage, or Pull Requests. - Automatically connects all configured and newly discovered harnesses at launch so their live model lists and status are ready immediately. - Expires the trackpad Forward page-swipe gesture 30 seconds after the last Back or Forward step so later leftward swipes on a conversation do not reopen an earlier page. - Fixes Pull Requests flickering and reloading repeatedly on first launch. - Fixes unsettled threads occasionally appearing as blank rows in the sidebar after being settled via a swipe gesture. - Hides transcript and composer scroll bars until scrolled when a mouse or legacy scroll bar setting is active.

- Settings, Usage and Pull Requests now open as pages of the main window instead of separate windows, with Back and Forward beside the traffic lights and a swipe anywhere in the window to go back. - Settings is reorganized into clear panes, including a new Harnesses pane that shows every account with its settings inline. - Usage takes the whole window, folding the sidebar away and restoring it when you leave. - The pull request review page has a cleaner header, a Check Out split button, Ready for Review for drafts, and an Overview laid out in cards. - Adds Consolidate Memory Now and Memory Settings… to the Controller menu. - Fixes Factory Droid SDK sessions timing out while loading Controller's tools. - Fixes several main-thread hangs while typing, scrolling tool and reasoning output, and switching threads. - Keeps scroll bars out of the model picker when a mouse is connected. - On iPhone and iPad, Settings is reworked and paste and transcript scrolling are more responsive.

## Unified Agent Memory Repo
- **Shared cross-harness agent memory:** Adds a versioned, Git-backed Agent Memory Repo (`MEMORY.md`, `## Index`, and `[[path]]` topic files) shared across Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Droid, Grok, Antigravity, OpenCode, and Pi, with automatic one-time import from existing Claude Code, Codex, and Grok memories. - **Native `memory_*` tools and secret protection:** Exposes `memory_read`, `memory_write`, `memory_search`, `memory_log`, and `memory_reset` across harnesses, injects standing memory snapshots into sessions, and blocks Keychain credentials and secret patterns before writes or commits. - **Sandboxed background Dreaming:** Consolidates settled transcripts into durable personal and project memories during idle periods using any configured harness, with an on-demand **Consolidate Now** action and an **Auto-consolidate (Dream)** toggle in Settings. - **Controller Connect and end-to-end encrypted relay sync:** Synchronizes personal and project memory repositories peer-to-peer across connected Macs and through an end-to-end encrypted (`AES-GCM-256` + `X25519`/`HKDF-SHA256`) Cloudflare Worker relay so iPhone and iPad can inspect memories even when a host Mac is offline. - **Mac and iPhone memory controls and configuration browser:** Adds per-thread and app-wide memory toggles, inline diff and commit previews for `memory_*` tool calls, a structured Reset Memories confirmation, and personal/project memory browsing in the configuration viewer on macOS and iOS.
This release keeps version 1.0.45 and advances the build to 49.
